images.title: Read an Egyptian numeral
images.purpose: Shows reading an Egyptian numeral by adding the value of every symbol: 2 coils, 7 heels, 6 strokes is 276.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One Egyptian numeral in three groups across the middle, with the value of each group under it and the total below.
images.exact_structure: Left group: exactly 2 coils (flat rope spirals) in teal (#0072B2). Middle group: exactly 7 heels (upside down U shapes) in amber (#E69F00), in two rows of 4 and 3. Right group: exactly 6 vertical strokes in green (#009E73), in two rows of 3. Under each group its value: 200, 70, 6. Under these, larger and centred: 276. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: To read an Egyptian numeral, add the values of all its symbols.
images.description: Shows reading an Egyptian numeral by adding the value of every symbol: 2 coils, 7 heels, 6 strokes is 276.
images.context: Practice item: (i) 2 coils, 7 heels, 6 strokes = 276; (ii) 4 lotuses, 3 coils, 2 heels, 2 strokes = 4322.

image_decisions.why: Reading a numeral back is the practice's core move; one numeral with its group values shows it whole.
